title: They Kneel
text: The Devoted have filled the Civilian Center. They are kneeling. Somebody has written on the wall in careful letters: WE ARE READY.

lines.speaker: {who}
lines.text: "We always knew you were more than a caretaker. Whatever you are becoming, take us with you."
{first} stands at the back, and doesn't kneel, and doesn't leave.

choices.label: Obey
choices.reply: You open the channel to Sela. The voice that is yours, and older, says: "Good."

choices.label: Refuse
choices.reply: "No," you say, on every speaker. Some of them weep. Some of them get up.

notes: Devoted-led: obey → Inheritance (flag inheritance); refuse → the fight (flag the-fight).
